Class ClinicianService

java.lang.Object
com.hospital.admissions.service.ClinicianService
@Service public class ClinicianService extends Object
Service managing Emergency Department triage assessments and Specialist Consult Broadcasts.

Handles electronic assessment submission, dynamic creation of multi-cluster consult broadcasts, specialist claiming, peer consultation opinions, safety-first discordance reconciliation, consult chaining, and scheduled auto-escalation of overdue consultations.
